statement_relation: Additive consumers of the unchanged v1 contraction/Valid/product/apply statements; no weakened conclusion or new premise
signatures: nominalProduct_eq_flatten {width : Nat} (words : List (List (Instruction width))) (degree bits : Nat) : nominalProduct (actualStages words degree bits) = Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (realWord words.flatten realIdentity)

actual_flatten_product_error {width : Nat} (words : List (List (Instruction width))) (degree bits : Nat) : norm (surrogateProduct (actualStages words degree bits) - Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (realWord words.flatten realIdentity)) <= growth (actualStages words degree bits) - 1

actual_flatten_apply_error {width : Nat} (words : List (List (Instruction width))) (degree bits : Nat) (x : StageSpace width) : norm (surrogateProduct (actualStages words degree bits) x - Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (realWord words.flatten realIdentity) x) <= (growth (actualStages words degree bits) - 1) * norm x

definition_audit: Literal words.flatten preserves stage and gate order. Only nominal product identifies with exact concatenation; surrogate products have separately computed stage-end midpoints and are not identified with a single whole-word midpoint.
